tei:div.tei:p: "!# :thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ e ma ho: 'jig rten gsum mgon byams mgon thugs rje can: tshad med snying rjes 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa'i: gsang 'dus thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin don gnyis bsgrub bya'i phyir: las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba 'di nyid bstan: 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: sngon 'gro thun mong las rim bcu: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bka' bsgo zhing: mtshams bcad brda' sgo brda' phyag 'tshal: dam bca' byin dbab mchod bshags bya: dngos gzhi'i las khrigs nyer gsum ste: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gzhal yas khang: spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag dang glu: phyi nang gsang gsum sman gtor raka: sbyor sgrol de bzhin nyid kyi mchod: bstod bskul 'dzab bzla dngos grub blang: rjes kyi las khrigs bcu gcig ste: che ba bskyed cing tshogs phrin gdab: tshogs dang lhag mchod thugs dam bskul: chad mdo brtan skyong rta bro dang: dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing rgyun spyod bya: smon lam mtha' rgyas bkra shis brjod: 'di dag las gzhung rtsa thor bsdebs: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: 1$0000250spyi gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i steng: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs dang: skyabs gnas dkon mchog thams cad bsam: pha mas gtsor byas 'gro ba rnams: sgo gsum gus pas 'di skad brjod: 1$0000300na mo: bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: rang rig lha la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'gags rang gsal mchod par 'bul: mu bzhir lhung ba mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyam nyid rjes yi rang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bskul: ka dag zang thal rjen par bzhugs: kun kyang rang rig rtogs par bsngo: sku gsum yongs rdzogs thob par shog: de nas sems bskyed pa ni: kye ma: bdag gis 'gro kun bsgral bya'i phyir:

thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir: tshad med bzhi ru sems bskyed do: de nas bka' bsgo bgegs gtor sbyin: hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: nga ni 'jigs byed dbang gi sku: gal te bka' las 'das pa na: khyod kyi lus ngag rdul phran bzhin: brlag par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min: de bas rang gi gnas su dengs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: ghṛh+ṇa ghṛh+ṇa hūm̐: ghṛh+ṇa pā ya gh+rih+ṇa pā ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān: bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas mtshams bcad rang nyid lha: rngam brjid 'jigs pa'i nga rgyal bskyed: hūm̐: nga ni thugs rje'i rang rtsal las: 'bar ba'i rta mgrin dbang gi sku: sku las mtshon cha'i thog ser 'phro: bskal pa'i me dpung dmar nag 'bar: khro chung rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'khrugs: bgegs kyi tshogs rnams brlag par 'gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gh+rī wa ma hā kro dha da ha pa tsa ban+dha ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas brda yi sgo yang dbye: hūm̐: thugs rje'i rang rtsal rang byung ye shes lha: 'khor 'das thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang: ma rig rang gsang thabs kyis sgo bcad pa: rang rig rang gsal dag pa'i sgo phyes shig: bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas brda yi phyag kyang 'tshal: hūm̐: 'khor 'das thams cad rang byung thugs rje che: kun khyab rang byung ye shes don ma rtogs: rang gsal mtha' dbus med kyang mu bzhir gol: don dam snying po'i rang bzhin mjal phyag 'tshal: gu ru lo ke shwa ra a ti pū ho: de nas rgyun gyi dam bca' bzung: hūm̐: thugs rje'i rang rtsal rgyu drug 'khor ba sbyangs: thog ma med pa'i dus nas yi dam lha: dus 'dir rang byung snying po'i don rtogs pas: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sa ma ya: tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya dza: de nas gsang ba'i byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī:

rnam dag spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las: ma 'gags thugs rje'i rang rtsal gtso dang 'khor: gnas 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi byin phob la: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sarba sa ma ya ā we sha ya ā: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab: hrī: gsang 'dus thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs rnams: snang srid thams cad yongs bkang nas: gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta gha ṇa ghu h+ya sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa byin brlab bo: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma gsang 'dus zhi khro'i tshogs: bdag ni rmongs shing gti mug pas: ma rig dbang gis nyams chag sogs: 'gal 'khrul thams cad mthol lo bshags: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sarba sa ma ya shud+dhe a: de nas dngos gzhi'i las khrigs las: ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum nyid de: hūm̐: spros med chos rnams ye nas dag: mtha' bzhi'i dri ma rang sangs nyid: ka dag zang thal chos kyi sku: 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du bdal: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: gdod nas bde chen chos kyi sku: rang ngo ma shes 'khrul pa'i dbang: gzung 'dzin las la rab tu 'thas: de nyid ma rtogs snying re rje: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa shud+dhe ā: hūm̐: 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das: rgyu yi ngo bo gcig nyid de: hrīḥni ye shes snying po'i srog: rten 'brel rgyu yi sa bon bsgom: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: hrīḥtsit+ta badz+ra sa mā dhi hūm̐:

de nas pho brang gzhal yas bskyed: hūm̐: e las stong gsal nam mkha'i dbyings: yaṃ las stobs chen rdo rje'i rlung: ra las rgya mtsho mu mtha' med: suṃ las dbang chen gser gyi gzhi: keṃ las gru gsum ri rab brjid: raṃ las me dpung phyogs bcur 'bar: dug lnga gnas su dag pa las: dbang chen yum lnga'i mkha' klong dbus: hrīḥlas bh+rūm̐ 'phros gzhal yas khang: ma bcos rang byung 'od lnga'i klong: rab mdzes phyi nang zang thal gsal: dal dbus pad+ma'i snying po zlum: mu khyud phyi nang pad 'dab mdzes: gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rdzogs: rin chen sna lnga'i rtsig pa la: ye shes rlung gi khor yug can: zla phyed rdo rje'i skar khung mdzes: 'dod yon lha mo'i gar gyis dkrig: pho brang mnyam yangs 'od du 'khyil: ma bcos lhun gyis grub par gsal: ngo mtshar rmad byung rgyal ba'i gnas: gzhal yas yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe: e dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: pad+ma sūr+ya: tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor lha rnams bskyed: hūm̐ hrī: dal dbus hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: rang rig pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: gsang 'dus zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dmar gsal rin chen rgyan rdzogs spras: phyag g.yas pad phreng thugs kar bsnams: phyag g.yon pad sdong bdud rtsi'i bum: gsang ye sku la gnyis med 'khril: dmar gsal gzhon tshul rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas pad+ma gri gug 'khyud: phyag g.yon tshe bum snyan du 'dzin: 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan dbu skra grol: rgyan drug pad phreng do shal mdzes: thabs kyi sku dang gnyis med 'khril: gsang 'dus sku yi dbu gtsug tu: rigs bdag mtha' yas sku mdog dmar: thugs kar rta mgrin rngam brjid 'jigs: nyid las gnyis med sprul pa'i sras: nor 'dzin g.yas la gsang 'dzin g.yon: sku mdog dkar dmar pad phreng 'dzin: kun gyi spyi gtsug rig bdag brgyan:

de yi phyi rim phyogs bzhi dbus: 'dab bzhi 'ja' 'od lnga yi dkyil: thugs rje'i rgyal ba rigs mchog lnga: shar du mi bskyod mā kī mthing: rdo rje dril 'dzin yum dang 'khril: lho ru rin 'byung spyan ma ser: rin chen dril 'dzin yum dang 'khril: nub tu snang mtha' gos dkar dmar: pad+ma dril 'dzin yum dang 'khril: byang du don grub sgrol ma ljang: rgya gram dril 'dzin yum dang 'khril: dbus mdun rnams snang dbyings phyug dkar: 'khor lo dril 'dzin yum dang 'khril: kun kyang dbu rgyan cod pan dang: rin chen rgyan mdzes mdangs dang ldan: de yi phyi rim 'dab brgyad la: rigs 'dus sems dpa' yab yum brgyad: shar du sa snying lā se dkar: rin chen myu gu me long 'dzin: shar lhor byams pa puṣ+pe dkar: klu shing dril bu me tog 'dzin: lho ru nam snying dhū pe mthing: ral gri dril bu spos phor 'dzin: lho nub sgrib sel gan+dhe dkar: pusti dril bu dung phor 'dzin: nub tu spyan ras gī ti dmar: pad+ma dril bu pi waṃ 'dzin: nub byang kun bzang mā le mthing: rin chen dril bu phreng ba 'dzin: byang du phyag rdor nīrti ljang: rdo rje dril bu zhal zas 'dzin: byang shar 'jam dpal ā lo ser: ut+pal dril bu mar me 'dzin: de ltar rigs kyi yab yum rnams: phyed skyil sems dpa'i g.yon nas ni: 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan yum rnams 'khyud: dbu rgyan cod pan do shal dang: phyag zhabs gdu bu dar dpyang spras: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can: 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan par bskyed: de yi phyi rim pad+ma drug: rin chen mdzes pa'i 'dzum bcas la: yi ge drug gi 'phro 'du las: brgya byin thags bzang shākya thub: rab brtan kha 'bar chos kyi rgyal: sku mdog dkar sngo ser gsal mdzes: ser nag ljang dang de bzhin nag: brgya byin pi waṃ thags bzang mtshon:

shāka thub bsreg shang rab brtan chos: kha 'bar rin chen chos rgyal chu: kun kyang 'gro 'dul 'od zer can: sprul sku gzhon tshul ldan par bskyed: de yi phyi rim mu khyud bzhir: pad+ma stong ldan gdan stengs su: thugs rje'i rang rtsal 'gro ba 'dul: dus gsum sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis: gang 'dul sku mdog sna tshogs mdzes: sprul pa'i sku ru yongs rdzogs bskyed: hrī: sgo bzhir bdud bzhi pad nyi'i steng: shar du badz+ra he ru dkar: lcags kyu g.yas la sdigs mdzub g.yon: lho ru rat+na he ru ser: be con g.yas la zhags pa g.yon: nub tu pad+ma he ru dmar: dbyug to g.yas la lcags sgrog g.yon: byang du karma he ru ljang: rgya gram g.yas la dril bu g.yon: kun kyang rngam brjid 'jigs par bskyed: phyi rol bar khyams 'khor yug la: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can tshogs: dpag med 'ja' sprin lta bur 'thib: gang 'dul sgyu ma'i rol par shar: kun kyang ma 'dres 'ja' ltar bsgom: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sarba bha ga wān ma ṇi badz+ra ā: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sa ma ya dza: bskyed rim spros pa la mi dga' na las byang bsdus pa 'di nyid byas pas mi 'gal: de nas rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs pa ni: hūm̐: rnam dag bde chen gzhal yas nas: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lhun grub longs sku'i zhing khams nas: rgyal ba rigs lnga gshegs su gsol: phyogs bcu dag pa'i zhing khams nas: sems dpa' yab yum gshegs su gsol: 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: rgyal ba thub drug gshegs su gsol: phyogs bcu dus gsum zhing khams nas: sangs rgyas stong rtsa gshegs su gsol: phrin las bzhi yi dkyil 'khor nas: sgo bzhi'i khro rgyal gshegs su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni:

hrī: dam tshig dbang gis dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'gro la phan mdzad thugs rje'i bdag: mkha' dang 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du: dbye bsal med par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: thugs rje'i rang rtsal zhi dang khro: ma 'gags rang gsal cir yang snang: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las la: sgo gsum dad pas phyag bgyi 'o: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: de nas glu yi mchod pa ni: hrī: snang stong zung 'jug dbyings kyi glu: rtog bral 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang: glu ni thabs shes dbyer med glu: bro ni bde ba chen por brdung: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: shū ma hā dz+nyā na te te hūm̐ te na hūm̐: de nas phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mdzes pa'i me tog spyan la 'bul: dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul: snang gsal mar me thugs la 'bul: bde ba'i dri chab sku la 'bul: ro ldan zhal zas ljags la 'bul: sgra snyan rol mo snyan la 'bul: thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: de nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ste: 'dod pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho gtibs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod tshogs 'bul: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni: hrī: thabs shes gnyis su med pa las: byang sems bde ba'i rang bzhin mchog: bde ba'i ro snyoms mchod par bzhes: sku lus rgyas phyir pū dza ho: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā pū dza ho: de nas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni: hrī:

rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi mchog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hrī: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos: thugs rje'i rang bzhin lha tshogs la: gus pas 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: de bzhin du lha tshogs thams cad la mtshan don sbyar: de nas gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: snang srid bde chen gtor gzhong du: rang byung 'khor 'das gtor mar sbyar: ma lus 'dus pa'i tshogs chen po: thugs rje'i lha tshogs bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hrī: rgyu drug rang bzhin dbyings su bsgral: 'dod chags rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs: blo ngan 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod phyir: rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni: hrī: thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med: bde chen 'du 'bral med par sbyar: bde ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba che: thugs rje'i lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pad+ma yo gi nī mu dra pra we sha ya phaṭa: sarba pū dza ho:

de nas bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni: hrī: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang: nga rgyal phrag dog dug lnga ni: ye shes lnga yi ngo bo ru: ye nas ro gcig chos kyi sku: rang ngo rtogs grol rang sar bsgral: thams cad ye rdzogs chen por bzhes: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ma traṃ ru dra pra bhan tsakra kha raṃ khā hi: de nas de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: hrī: ka dag zang thal chos kyi sku: spros pa med pa dbyings kyi ngang: nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' thim: ye mchod chen por bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ pū dza ho: de nas bstod pa'i rim pa ni: hrī: bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs rje'i lha: rang byung ye shes spyan ras gzigs: dmar gsal pad phreng bum pa 'dzin: gsang ye rang 'dra'i yum dang 'khril: rab mdzes rgyan rdzogs 'od lnga'i klong: nyi zla pad steng dgyes par bzhugs: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs rigs kyi bdag: tshe yi bdag po sku mdog dmar: mnyam gzhag tshe bum rgyan rdzogs spras: 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs srog ye shes sems dpa'i sku: dbang chen dmar po gri thod 'dzin: rta skad 'tsher zhing bdud bzhi 'dul: dbang sdud mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: sras mchog nor 'dzin gsang sngags 'dzin: dkar dmar rgyan mdzes pad phreng 'dzin: thabs kyi 'gro 'dul rig pa 'dzin: bde stong sras la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: stong gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: lhun grub rgyal ba rigs mchog lnga: dag pa ye shes 'od lnga'i sku: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem sgeg bzhad ldan: gsal 'tsher gzhon tshul mdzes pa'i sku: rigs lnga yab yum sku la bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sras: rigs mchog sems dpa' yab yum brgyad: rab mdzes zhi ba'i ngang tshul can: thugs rje'i phrin las bsam mi khyab:

'gro 'dul byang sems dpag med bskor: yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren: rigs drug skyabs mchog thub pa drug: ma nges cir yang ston mdzad pa'i: sdug bsngal skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod: bskal bzang 'di la thugs bskyed nas: zhing 'dir mdzad pa rmad byung gi: gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dren: sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgo bzhir bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng: rang byung khro rgyal chen po bzhi: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul: bdud dpung 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang bka' 'dus gsang ba yi: dkyil 'khor phyi nang lha yi tshogs: zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod las: phrin las sgrub cing dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can bcas: yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bskul ba'i rim pa ni: hrī: chos dbyings rol pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes las grub rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bkod pa sku yi rnam 'phrul dpag med cing: mdzad pa'i phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: rang snang dgongs brgyud dag pas thugs dam bskul: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bsnyen sgrub 'dzab la sbyar: hrī: gsang 'dus thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor du: rang byung ye shes 'od kyi klong: 'ja' tshon lnga yi mu khyud 'khrigs: pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng: gsang 'dus thugs rje spyan ras gzigs: tshe bdag rta mgrin gsang ye yum: nor 'dzin gsang 'dzin rigs lngar bcas: sems dpa' yab yum thub pa drug: sangs rgyas stong rtsa sgo ba bzhi: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs: ma 'dres nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar gsal: rgyan rdzogs gzi brjid ldan pa'i sku: phyag rgya gar stabs shigs se shig: brjod med rang byung rdo rje'i sgra: 'dzab dbyangs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: mnyam yangs mi rtog spros bral thugs:

ma 'gags rang rtsal thugs rje shar: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med cing: bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru ma phyin bar: nam yang mi gtang bsgrub par bgyi'o: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐ hrī: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+rī wa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ swā ā hā: mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: oṃ ka pa tsa wa: kha pha tsha ya: ga pa dza ra: pha gha la dz+nyā na swā hā: oṃ mu ne k+ṣaṃ ye kruṃ kreṃ nri tri hūm̐: oṃ bud+dha dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: dkyil 'khor dal la 'chams shing bskor: bsnyen sgrub 'dzab la nan tan bskyed: bdun 'bum nyis khri grangs dang ni: zhal mthong lung ston rtags dang sbyar: dngos grub ngo mtshar mchog thob 'gyur: de nas dngos grub blang chog bya: ban+dha dza gad nying khus bkang: dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman gdab: rdo rje slob dpon phyag tu thogs: 'brang rgyas zas sna tshogs tshad bsags: rim par bshams la dkyil 'khor shar sgor/ mngar gsum bdud rtsis bran la bzhag: thams cad lug rgyud sgor mor sbrel: dngos grub sdud pa'i phyag rgya bya: dngos grub blang ba'i 'dzab 'di bzla: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrī: zhes pa brgya'am stong tshar nas: thugs dam bskul zhing dngos grub blang: hrī: dgongs shig thugs rje che mnga' ba: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs: dang por bsnyen cing bar du bsgrub: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: bdag cag rnams la bstsal du gsol: de nas las la sbyar ba ni: dngos grub bdud rtsi zhal zas la: yang yang bstim zhing rnal 'byor rnams: rings par rings par lhag mi bzhag: dus gcig dag la rol par bya: 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab: des ni mchog dang thun mong gi:

dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de rnams dngos gzhi'i rim pa 'o: de nas rjes kyi las khrigs las: dang po che ba bskyed pa ni: hrī: stong gsum 'jig rten dbang gi dal: ye shes me dpung phyogs bcur 'bar: gzugs snang thams cad khro bo'i rgyal: dbang gi rta skad stong gsum khengs: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud: snang srid thams cad bran du 'khol: stong gsum 'di na su yang rung: nga las che btsan su yang med: nga yis bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin du: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐: hrīḥhrī: bh+yo bh+yo: de nas tshogs kyi rim pa rnams: zhing lpags stag lpags la sogs pa: tshogs gdan tsang ma'i steng du bzhag: zas sna yo byad tshogs tshad bsham: bdud rtsi bsang chu gtor byas nas: rdo rje rgyal po'i mdun dag tu: tshogs las pa rnams thal sbyar te: byin rlabs zhu tshogs phrin las gdab: ho: dgongs su gsol lo: spros med lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dam pa nas: thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs yab yum sras 'khor: rigs lnga'i rgyal ba: sems dpa' yab yum lcam dral: sprul sku thub pa drug: sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis: sgo bzhi skyong ba'i khro bo: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir 'dus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam dral dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mchod cing: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi g.yar dam sor stsol phyir: zab mo tshogs kyi mchod pa gzhung bzhin du 'bul lags na: brtse ba dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes pa ci gnang: zhes zhus pa'i lan du rdo rje slob dpon gyis: e ma ho: thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis thugs rjes ni gzigs: byams pas ni dgongs: gnas mchog 'di yang he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor:

rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dbu gtso: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir 'dus pa thams cad lha dang lha mo dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rang bzhin kho na yin pas: thugs rjes gzigs shing rjes su bzung ste bzhes par gnang gis 'byor tshogs gzhung bzhin du drongs shig: a la la ho: de nas tshogs sbyang ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: rig pa'i ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: raṃ las ye shes me byung bas: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs: yaṃ las ye shes rlung byung bas: tshogs kyi bag chags thams cad gtor: khaṃ las ye shes chu byung bas: tshogs su 'dzin pa'i gnyis 'dzin bkru: de nas tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni: hrī: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: rgyu yi 'bru bzhi gtan la dbab: spro bsdu'i sbyor bas 'dod yon tshogs: longs spyod dpag tu med par gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyangs: āḥ āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: oṃ oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid gang: hrīḥ hrīḥyis mthong snang lha tshogs dgyes: rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ: de nas thog mar tshogs kyi lha spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: thugs rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: ye shes tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hrī: 'di na sna tshogs gzugs mchis kyi: gzugs kyi lha mos me long thogs: kun kyang spyan dang gshegs su gsol: 'di na sna tshogs sgra mchis kyi: sgra yi lha mos pi waṃ thogs: kun kyang snyan dang gshegs su gsol: 'di na sna tshogs dri mchis kyi: dri yi lha mos spos khang thogs: kun kyang shangs dang gshegs su gsol: 'di na sna tshogs ro mchis kyi:

ro yi lha mos zhal zas thogs: kun kyang ljags dang gshegs su gsol: 'di na sna tshogs reg mchis kyi: reg gi lha mos na bza' thogs: kun kyang sku dang gshegs su gsol: 'di na sna tshogs chos mchis kyi: chos kyi lha mos rdor dril thogs: kun kyang thugs dang gshegs su gsol: 'dod yon lha mo dpag med tshogs: nam mkha' khyab pa'i gar byed cing: ye shes tshogs la gshegs su gsol: e h+ye hi sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: de nas tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spro ste: dang po mchod pa ni: hrī: gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa ni: 'dod pa'i longs spyod sprin tshogs gtibs: bde chen lha mos gar gyis bsgyur: mchod bzhes dbang dang dngos grub stsol: gu ru lo ke shwa ra de wa ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar pa bshags pa bya ba ni: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: bdag cag ma rig rmongs gyur te: phud la gzhol zhing lhag la 'phris: ser sna'i dbang gis 'byor tshogs chung: le lo'i dbang gis dus ma bskangs: lta sgom mi ldan ting 'dzin g.yel: 'khrul pas yang dag don ma rtogs: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang: bskangs nas dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni: gzas pa po'i sha khrag rū pa ming rus dang bcas pa bshams la: sgrol ging dkar nag las mkhan du gsal: lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bden pa'i stobs brjod: gzu dpang 'gugs bstim drag tu bya: phur pa 'dril zhing stod rta mgrin dmar po me 'bar ba: smad phur pa me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba mgar gyi sol mal nas byung ba ltar bskyed la: hūm̐: nga ni rab 'jigs dbang gi rgyal: rta skad 'tsher zhing srid gsum gzir: khro tshogs mang po sprin ltar gtibs: pho nya las mkhan glog ltar 'khyug: gnam lcags phur pa mkha' la 'dril: lcags kyu zhags pa klad la bskor: btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur: dgra bgegs 'byung po smos ci dgos:

rol cig choms shig mā ra ya: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlogs: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta ma hā kro dha dgra bgegs 'byung po sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: ces bsgral te zhal du 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyes shig phyes shig zhal phyes shig: thugs nyid zhi ba'i ngang nyid las: ma rungs 'dul phyir khro bo'i tshul: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bstim mo ā ral+li: zhes dgra bgegs dngos su dmigs la 'bul lo: de nas rdo rje slob dpon la phul ba'i rjes su lhag phud bcad la rim par drangs te: hrī: gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: 'di la the tshom byar mi rung: bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: ces drang ngo: len pa pos kyang pad+ma'i phyag rgyas 'di skad brjod la blang: a la la ste ngo mtshar che: rin thang med las legs 'ongs chos: 'dod chags dri ma dang bral zhing: gzung dang 'dzin pa kun spangs pa'i: de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal: zhes pas rol lo: tshogs kyi smon lam gdab pa ni: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: rigs ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: bsod nams tshogs chen yongs rdzogs bskor: lha la lha thim ngo mtshar che: bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cig: ces dang: yang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la: ye shes tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yis: bdag gzhan bsod nams tshogs chen yongs rdzogs nas: ma lus dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces smon lam gdab bo: de nas lhag ma'i cho ga bya ste: dpal gtor nas kyu gu gcig phab la lhag mar bskul te: dkyil 'khor nas phab ste stegs la bzhag nas rak+tas bran la: hrī: dbang chen thugs rje'i lha tshogs rnams: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kun: rmad byung gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bskang dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hrī: pad+mān+ta kṛta sa ma ya de wī kro dha sarba ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi:

zhes sman phud dang kha phru btab la tha tshig brjod pa ni: hrī: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: dpal chen lha tshogs phud kyi bdag: de nas lhag mas mi mchod rgyu: ma mo mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes: tha ma gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: chos nyid ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig: lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu: khyod dang bdag nyid dam tshig gcig: dkyil 'khor mtha' la mi bzhag rgyu: bran g.yog pho mo'i tshul du gnas: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud rnams: dbang chen rta yi bka' sdod tshogs: las rnams zhal gyis bzhes pa yi: dpal gyi bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro ging dang lang kar bcas: ma bdun sring bzhi dur khrod bdag: 'bar ma dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: mdzes pa'i sku la sgeg tshul can: me tog chun 'phyang ska rags bcings: rat+na'i gzhong thogs gtor len ma: phra men mngag gzhug byed pa'i tshogs: bka' yi pha 'bab 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: zhes btang ngo: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hrī: ma bcos lhun grub bde chen zhing khams nas: rang byung ye shes thugs rje'i lha tshogs rnams: ma 'gags 'gro ba 'dul bar thugs dam bskul: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga'i tshogs: dug lnga rtsad nas gcod par thugs dam skul: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: phyogs dus bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rnam thar brgyad ldan byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag par thugs dam skul: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: 'gro 'dul sprul pa sku yi zhing khams nas: bcom ldan thub pa drug gi thugs dam skul: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: mdzad pa rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:

'gro 'dul sangs rgyas stong gi thugs dam skul: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: tshad med rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi nas: khro rgyal sgo skyong bzhi yi thugs dam skul: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar khyams khor yug nas: rig 'dzin bka' sdod tshogs kyi thugs dam skul: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: nub phyogs bde chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru kas: rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags nas snang srid ma mo btul: tha tshig gsum gyis dam la btags pa'i tshe: rdo rje phag mo la sogs mkha' 'gro bye ba brgyas: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la: shar phyogs ri bo ta la'i pho brang du: thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa yis: 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag nyi shu yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og bar gyi dus tshigs dbus ma la: dpal gyi bsam yas ar+ya pa gling du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang: slob ma'i dwangs ma rje 'bangs nyer lnga yis: 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog= g.yar dam can la= bka' yi gtor ma= bcol ba'i phrin las= sngon tshe zhal bzhes= sha khrag dmar gyi= rnal 'byor bcol ba'i= de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i tha ma la: lho brag mkhar chu gnyan gyi dben gnas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: nam snying mtsho rgyal rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang: lang gro lo tsā shel dkar rdo rje mtshos:

gsang 'dus thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bse lang mkha' 'gro bka' sdod sgrol ging dang: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: rang snang ma 'gags dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: chos kyi bdag po rat+na gling pa yis: gsang 'dus thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: thugs rje'i bstan skyong dam can thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang: thugs rje chen po'i rjes 'jug brgyud 'dzin rnams: bcol ba'i las mdzad bu bzhin skyong ba dang: rtag tu srung zhing skyob bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas gtor ma dpag ste brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: dgung sngon steng dang gangs ri g.ya' rtse dang: spang ljongs skyed mos tshal dang nags 'dabs dang: gangs can mtha' dbus kun la gnas pa yi: 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: gnod sbyin dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: kong lha g.yu bun kha rag khyung btsun ma: me tog zla 'od byang gi ting mo btsun: gser thar ma dang kun bzang shān+tiṃ dpal: klu mo chen mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa: khyed rnams sngon gyi zhal bzhes g.yar dam can: rang rang gnas nas ma lus 'dir byon la: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas de bzhin du: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor 'khor srungs rkyen zlog bar chad sol:

bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: ma ma hring ma ma hring: i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor gzhong bdud rtsis bshal la mchod do: de nas rta bro bya ba ni: gtor gzhong ri rab 'og tu dgra bgegs dam sri 'gugs gzhug drag tu byas te mched lcam rnams lag pa lug rgyud sbrel la: hūm̐ hrī: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor 'dir: bar chad dam sri 'dul ba'i lha: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: gtum chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing: dpal gyi rta skad tse re re: khro bo'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: bdud dang dam sri rdul du rlog: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta h+ya gh+rī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ya ma dam sri s+t+wam+bha ya nan: ces bros mnan no: de nas rdo rjes dkyil 'khor mtha' nas bsdu zhing: hūm̐: chos sku skye med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang: thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor ma 'dres yongs rdzogs shar: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal nas: slar yang chos dbyings skye med ngang du mu: zhes ā li kā li dang yi ge brgya pas kha bskang: ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu: ye shes lha tshogs gnas 'dir byon pa legs: bdag sogs 'gro rnams bsod nams skal par ldan: dmigs med sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang: slar yang thugs rjes 'byon par mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ mu: de nas rgyun spyod la 'jug pa ni: hrī: bdag nyid sgyu ma chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rjes skur bzhengs nas: stong dang thugs rje'i snying rje zung 'brel bas: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: de nas smon lam gdab pa ni: bla ma dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag gis dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub lta sgom spyod: sbyin sogs dge bcu ci spyad pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur te:

bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyis: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: hrī: dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas gter: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: 'gro ba ma lus 'dren mdzad pa'i: gsang 'dus thugs rje'i bkra shis shog: dus min 'chi las skyob mdzad pa'i: 'od dpag med pa'i bkra shis shog: bar chad bdud dpung 'joms mdzad pa'i: rta mgrin dbang gi bkra shis shog: sku lnga ye shes mngon gyur pa'i: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bkra shis shog: tshogs brgyad gnas su dag mdzad pa'i: sems dpa' brgyad kyi bkra shis shog: yul brgyad gnas su dag mdzad pa'i: sems ma brgyad kyi bkra shis shog: rigs drug sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa'i: thub pa drug gi bkra shis shog: gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i: sangs rgyas stong gi bkra shis shog: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub mdzad pa'i: sgo ba bzhi yi bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa'i don sgrub pa'i: dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: ces rgya cher brjod cing skabs su rol mo sgrog la me tog 'thor ro: de nas dga' ston gyi tshogs 'khor bya: bkra shis pa'i glu bro gar la sogs pa rnams nyams ci dgar bskyang zhing rol lo: gsang sngags gsang ba'i phyir mtha' rjes mi mngon par bya'o: rjes su dus dang rnam pa kun tu yang: phyi snang ba'i yul la ma chags par tshogs drug lhug pa zang thal le: nang 'dzin pa'i sems ma bcos dmigs gtad dang bral ba'i ngang du rjen ne: lhang nge: rnyogs pa med par dwangs sang nge: shar grol du khrol le: gdangs ma 'gags pa lha yi skur krong nge: sgra grags stong bsnyen sgrub tu 'u re: blo bral chos skur shig ge bar bzhag par bya ste: rnam pa kun tu sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum dang mi 'bral bar bya ba ni: bla med gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ste: rgyun du de lta bu dang mi 'bral bar bya'o: thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po pad+mas mdzad pa:

bdag 'dra a tsar ye shes kyis la yag mon mkhar steng du yi ger bkod pa'o: : bdag 'dra rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rdo rje yis: thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa 'di: shin tu zab phyir gnam skas brag la sbas: da lta bstan cing spel ba'i dus min pas: snyigs ma lnga dus pre ta bod khams rnams: 'gro mgon thugs rje'i bstan pas 'dul bar 'gyur: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: rga/rga/rga: man+t+ra gu h+ya: ྈྈྈྈྈ sprul pa'i skyes mchog rat+na gling pas gnam skas brag nas khrom gter byas nas gdan drangs pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// //
